svg.title: Trickbound · Town and station v2 (#21) · Direction A: Painted top-down
svg.text: Trickbound · Town and station v2 (#21) · Direction A: Painted top-down
Cinder Hollow, Leg 1. Concept sheet, code-drawn SVG (no image model). Hex codes only from art/art-direction.md (draft).
The town at phone size (1x, 384 × 480 view)
The station interior at phone size (1x, 384 × 320 view)
2x detail: a card table under the lamp
States: Arrival (one lamp of two working) → Lamp-lit (the town’s first critter wakes)
In the game: phone frame (390 wide) with the UI and the hand on top
Tap a label or a person
Idea: keep today’s top-down grid and repaint each place as one loose oil-sketch backdrop; collision stays in code, so the walking works as is.
Risk: straight-down painting flattens buildings and faces, so it reads less “Revachol” than B or C and leans on lighting to carry the mood.
